appSettings.title: Settings
appSettings.themeHint: Affects the application interface only, not diagram colours.
appSettings.customThemesHint: Import a theme JSON file to use a custom colour scheme without rebuilding the app. Export the active theme as a starting point.
appSettings.themeImportInvalid: That file is not a valid theme (schemaVersion 1 with id, name, and tokens).
appSettings.themeEditorHint: Edit a custom theme. Changes preview live in the interface. Light and Dark built-in themes cannot be overwritten — create a custom theme from them instead.
appSettings.themeEditorEmptyHint: Create a custom theme to start editing colours. Built-in Light and Dark themes stay unchanged.
appSettings.themeEditorUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save to keep them, or Revert to discard the draft.
appSettings.themeEditorFontHint: UI font for the application chrome. Custom fonts fall back to Arial if unavailable. Diagram text uses Diagram properties → Font.
appSettings.languageHint: Affects the application interface, not text inside your diagram.
appSettings.autosaveHint: Automatically saves your diagram locally and restores it when you reopen the app.
appSettings.confirmBeforeNew: Confirm before starting a new diagram
appSettings.exportHint: Default values when opening the export dialog.
appSettings.clearRecoveryConfirm: Delete the locally saved recovery copy? Your current diagram on screen is not affected.
